title: BREAKING: Ryan Leopoldo Morales Arrested on First-Degree Burglary Charge
excerpt: Ryan Leopoldo Morales was arrested October 26, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department on a first-degree felony charge of burglary of a habitation, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Ryan Leopoldo Morales was arrested on October 26, 2026, at 7:17 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Morales is charged with burglary of a habitation with intent to commit another felony, a first-degree felony, and terroristic threat against a family or household member, a Class A misdemeanor. The charges are allegations, and Morales is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amounts were listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
